usage: 清蒸龍蝦 (cing1 zing1 lung4 haa1) is a noun that refers to a seafood dish made by steaming lobster.
When ordering food, you can say 'I want 清蒸龍蝦' to specify the steamed lobster dish.
The word can be used in menus, conversations about food, or when recommending dishes at a restaurant.
清蒸龍蝦 is often mentioned along with other seafood dishes in a meal.
It functions as the dish name, so it usually appears after quantity words, e.g., '一份清蒸龍蝦' (one portion of steamed lobster).
